Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.gitgui

Class GitRepository

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.gitgui.GitRepository
public final class GitRepository extends Object
The Git GUI backend: an AWT-free executor that drives the system git against one working directory and returns the parsed models (GitChange / GitCommit / GitBranch) plus raw GitResults for mutating commands.

The desktop bundles no JGit, so - exactly like the Security Center delegating to ClamAV and the VPN client delegating to nmcli - this class honestly shells out to the git on PATH through lg3d's ProcessRunner. When git is missing every query degrades to an empty result and every mutation to GitResult.NOT_STARTED, so the panel shows guidance instead of throwing or faking success.

The actual process launch is isolated behind the GitRepository.Runner seam so the whole class is unit-testable headless against canned git output with a fake runner - no repository and no git binary required.
